description: Configuration for the wall-framing auto-dimensioner. These values are project-specific and can be changed without recompiling the macro.
panelPrefixComment: Assembly-position prefix of wall panels. The automatic detection takes over when this matches nothing.

paperDistances.panelComment: Paper distance of a panel chain (bay chain), in mm
paperDistances.bandComment: Paper distance of a band chain, in mm

wallLayoutTitlesComment: Title fragments that identify a wall layout drawing. The macro works on any GA drawing whose title holds one of these fragments.

referenceDrawing.comment: The issued reference drawing. Section marks are copied from this drawing. Optional - if not found, section marks are skipped.

proSettings.comment: Settings for the Pro edition. These are loaded by WF_Pro.dll when available.
